root.label: Ranges and views
root.note: A range has begin and end; a view is a range cheap to move and destroy, composed lazily.

children.label: Range concepts
children.note: range needs ranges::begin and ranges::end in amortized constant time.

children.label: Sentinels
children.note: The end may have a different type from the iterator; common_range means they match.

children.label: sized_range
children.note: ranges::size in amortized O(1); filter_view is not sized.

children.label: viewable_range
children.note: A range that views::all can safely turn into a view.

children.label: constant_range
children.note: C++23: elements cannot be modified through the range's iterators.

children.label: What makes a view
children.note: range, movable and enable_view, plus semantic complexity rules.

children.label: Cheap operations
children.note: O(1) move, O(1) copy if copyable, destruction O(N+M) over N copies.

children.label: Opting in
children.note: Derive from view_interface or view_base, or specialize enable_view.

children.label: C++20 defect reports
children.note: P2325 dropped default construction; P2415 allowed move-only owning views.

children.label: Not a view
children.note: std::vector is a range but copying it is O(n), so enable_view is false.

children.label: views::all
children.note: Every adaptor converts its input with views::all first.

children.label: Views pass through
children.note: An argument that is already a view is copied or moved.

children.label: ref_view
children.note: Lvalue ranges are wrapped by pointer; the container must outlive the view.

children.label: owning_view
children.note: Rvalue containers are moved in; the result is move-only.

children.label: Lazy evaluation
children.note: Building a pipeline computes nothing; work happens on iteration.

children.label: Recomputed each pass
children.note: transform calls its function on every dereference, every time.

children.label: transform then filter
children.note: Kept elements are transformed twice: once by the predicate, once by the loop.

children.label: Caching and const
children.note: Views that cannot find begin in O(1) compute it once and store it.

children.label: Not const-iterable
children.note: filter, drop_while and some drop views lack a const begin().

children.label: Take by value
children.note: Generic code should accept views by value or auto&&, not const&.

children.label: Stale caches
children.note: Container operations that invalidate iterators also invalidate cached ones.

children.label: filter invariant
children.note: Writing a value that fails the predicate through filter_view is UB.

children.label: Materializing and looping
children.note: Views store no elements; containers and loops consume them.

children.label: ranges::to
children.note: C++23: builds a container, deducing the element type from a template.

children.label: Range-based for
children.note: Uses member or ADL begin and end, not ranges::begin; types may differ since C++17.
